title: Reconciliation & Report Batch Window Collision
root_cause: Reconciliation and report batches overlapped after a delayed scheduler start, exhausting subscriber DB connection pools and CPU.
root_cause_tr: Geciken scheduler baslangici nedeniyle reconciliation ve report batch pencereleri cakisti; subscriber DB connection pool ve CPU tukendi.
resolution_action: Report batch durduruldu, reconciliation tamamlanana kadar ertelendi; scheduler overlap guard aktif edildi.
lessons_learned: batch_overlap sinyali DB pool/CPU yukunden once geliyorsa ortak DB arizasindan ziyade scheduler penceresi incelenmelidir.
